mood: blue-black listening threshold with torn archive heat
material_language: rubberized black cable loops and hoses
glossy dark portal glass or luminous glass plate depth
torn printed poster paper and pasted archive strips
cassette plastic, leader tape, screws, and handwritten spine labels
lighting: Nocturnal cobalt light dominates, with the portal interior acting as the main glow source; cream metal catches side-lit scuffs, cables fall into charcoal shadow, flowers catch tiny white highlights, and occasional amber or magenta stage-light flecks puncture the dark field.
object_inventory: One major freestanding portal-machine mass should command the plate, surrounded by two to three secondary poster strata: cable-side darkness, blossom-side texture, and lower cassette/isometric ledge fragments.

The goo_vision portal is the main spatial anchor: its rim, interior horizon, vents, platform, cables, flowers, and base corners become the primary source-window territories. Ambient, cassette, krautrock, Ikeda, Comus, swamp-radio, and isometric-map sources appear as smaller physical interruptions in those territories: pasted sleeve shards, stage silhouettes, signal scratches, puppet-shadow tears, road-haze stains, and tiled ledges.
negative_constraints: no equal-weight grid of source objects
no unrelated replacement image or metaphorical scene when a source image is attached
game-surface rupture as the dominant grammar
